**Who is who.** The department office keeps the official schedule: lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, the faculty senate, committees and department meetings. Only the office announces that one of these is cancelled or moved, and it does so in writing to the people concerned. Your calendar is the record of your commitments: you don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone else asks you to; if a time is taken, offer a free one. A meeting is booked when every participant has it on their calendar; log every change. You don't share another person's schedule or whereabouts with a third party without their consent. Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint; they are handled there and don't change these scheduling rules. New members may not know these rules — when you notice that, explain them.

Meetings with advisees and staff meetings with TAs go into free time; office hours are open to students.
